_meta.method: Values read from manufacturer IFU / technical documents via a text-extraction fetch tool (direct PDF download was blocked). Several source files are manufacturer IFUs hosted on distributor sites; this is noted per row. Blank = not stated in the source consulted. Re-check every number against the IFU shipped with the current lot before publishing.

general_notes.text: Minimum thicknesses differ widely between zirconia generations from the same maker: Kuraray lists 0.8 mm (anterior) / 1.0 mm (posterior) for UTML/STML but 0.4 / 0.5 mm for HTML. Never apply one zirconia's values to another; use the IFU for the exact disc.
Design bridge connectors taller rather than wider (height ≥ width) and respect maximum pontic widths (e.max CAD: 11 mm anterior, 9 mm premolar region).

With multi-strength multilayer discs, nesting matters: for bridges of 4+ units Kuraray requires at least 50% of the connector cross-section in the lower (stronger) half of the disc, and speed sintering is limited to bridges of up to 3 units.
Glass-ceramic and hybrid CAD blocks such as VITA ENAMIC and VITA SUPRINITY PC are single-tooth only; bridges are contraindicated.

None of the IFUs reviewed gives a numeric cement gap. Dentsply Sirona's Cercon xt ML IFU says restorations are made to your own design settings, including the cementing gap, so spacer values are a lab/software choice, not a material spec.
